title.zh: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
title.en: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages

current_state.zh: The U.S. CFTC issued one rule and proposed another to formally classify certain event contracts on prediction-market platforms as 'swaps' under its exclusive oversight, hardening its legal position against states challenging its jurisdiction.
current_state.en: The U.S. CFTC issued one rule and proposed another to formally classify certain event contracts on prediction-market platforms as 'swaps' under its exclusive oversight, hardening its legal position against states challenging its jurisdiction.
